# Per-step comparison (generated by analyze.py)

free = exact g=0 (Gaussian); Hartree = time-dependent Hartree; PT2 = free + a2 (exact O(g^2), Wick; a1 = 0 exactly);
TEBD ref = free + [TEBD(g) − TEBD(0)] at the largest χ available (χ in column). "χ-conv" = |shift(χmax) − shift(next lower χ)|; "trunc" = raw TEBD(g=0) − free at χmax (truncation error that the difference cancels).
